language_scope.out_of_scope_policy: Flag non-English, mixed-language, or uncertain speech for review; do not silently classify it as English.

classification_taxonomy.target_speaker_policy: Use a speaker label only when the target is supported by transcript/context; otherwise null.
classification_taxonomy.inference_policy: Observable timing/order is not by itself proof of conversational intent. Use transcript evidence and abstain when evidence is insufficient.

source.title: Rahul Gandhi Ups Ante On 'Vote Chori'! BJP Mocks Ramlila Rally, Says 'India Isn't His Fiefdom'

notes: This artifact is a separate analysis output; it does not modify final.json or any existing pipeline stage.
Transcript text and source segment timestamps are preserved exactly; events may extend beyond the 3-second window and are flagged.
All classification and host-behavior fields are intentionally unclassified pending manual verification and later LLM analysis.
first_speaker_in_window accounts for speech already active at the window boundary; first_new_speaker_after_overlap separately records a segment beginning after the overlap.
Tied or ambiguous speaker starts are represented as null rather than forcing a conclusion.
Speaker labels are diarization labels, not verified real-world identities.
